response.what_it_is: Toyota 4-cylinder engine and automatic transmission assembly
visible_condition: chalk or marker markings on intake manifold
hidden_risks: Internal engine wear, scoring, or mechanical damage
Unknown compression levels and operating history
Discrepancy between title displacement (2.7) and typical 2AZ engine specs (2.4L)
Condition of seals, gaskets, and internal components
response.best_proof: A video showing a professional compression test or inspection of the cylinder bores and valve train.
response.failure_mode: Failing to recognize displacement discrepancies in the title (2AZ is typically 2.4L while title says 2.7) or assuming the warehouse background implies a bundle rather than a single engine unit.
